title: ClientMessage
description: Every message a client may send to the server.

Hello.title: Hello
Hello.description: First message on a new connection, with the driver's name and colour.

name.description: The driver's name as others see it; empty lets the server name them.

color.description: The vehicle's paint as #rrggbb; left out, the vehicle keeps its own colours.

token.description: Chosen by the browser tab and kept across reconnects: coming back with it within a minute keeps the same player.

SetWorld.title: SetWorld
SetWorld.description: Asks the server to change the clock or the weather for everyone. Any field left out stays as it is.

hour.description: Local time of day to jump to, in hours (0 midnight, 13.5 half past one). The date stays.

day.description: Day of the year to jump to (1 is 1 January), in the same year and at the same time of day.

dayMinutes.description: Real minutes one in-game day takes from now on; 0 stops the clock, 1440 is real time.

weather.description: A state to hold the weather in, or auto to let it change by itself.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: A new name or colour for this driver.

name.description: The driver's name as others see it; empty lets the server name them.

color.description: The vehicle's paint as #rrggbb; left out, the vehicle keeps its own colours.

VehicleSnapshot.title: VehicleSnapshot
VehicleSnapshot.description: How a driver's vehicle stands at one moment, sent about 20 times a second so others can draw it.

region.description: The region being driven; others draw the vehicle only in the same one.

jump.description: Goes up whenever the vehicle is put somewhere new, so others jump it there instead of sliding it.

t.description: The sender's clock, milliseconds; only differences between its own snapshots matter.

paused.description: The driver has paused: the vehicle stands still.

q.description: Rotation of the body, quaternion x, y, z, w.

v.description: Velocity of the body, metres a second.

wheels.description: Per wheel, in the definition's order: steering angle (radians), suspension length (metres), sink into soft ground (metres), drive spin (0..1), brake skid (0..1), sideways slide (m/s) and water over the ground under it (metres).

ground.description: Per wheel, the kind of ground under the tyre, empty while it is off the ground.

engine.description: What the engine is doing, for its sound and exhaust.

shifting.description: A gear change in progress: no drive.

drowned.description: Water has got into the engine and stopped it.

wading.description: Deepest water around the vehicle, metres above the bottom of its tyres.

Away.title: Away
Away.description: This driver's vehicle has left the road (back at the start screen): others stop drawing it.

Chat.title: Chat
Chat.description: A line of chat to everyone.

Push.title: Push
Push.description: Our vehicle pushed against another driver's vehicle: the push for their browser to apply, since only it moves that vehicle.

to.description: The player whose vehicle was pushed.

impulse.description: Impulse on their vehicle, newton-seconds, world frame.

at.description: Where it pushed, world position, metres.
